#!/usr/bin/env python3

# Define facts
copenhagen = True    # Copenhagen IS the capital of Denmark ✓
munich = False       # Munich is NOT the capital of Germany (Berlin is) ✗
cameroon = True      # Yaounde IS the capital of Cameroon ✓
jordan = True        # Amman IS the capital of Jordan ✓
canada = False       # Toronto is NOT the capital of Canada (Ottawa is) ✗
iran = False         # Isfahan is NOT the capital of Iran (Tehran is) ✗
uae = False          # Dubai is NOT the capital of UAE (Abu Dhabi is) ✗

# Expression A
A = not not not (
    (not not (not (not copenhagen and munich) and (not (-5 - (6 / -3) <= -6) and (-2 * -9 + -1 * 1 > 3 * -3)))
    or 
    not not not (not (not not (7 * -5 + 1 * -5 <= -6 * 6) or not not not (max(-6, -9, 3, -2) - min(-6, -9, 3, -2) > 6)) or (not not True or not not not (max(-3, -7, 6, -7) - min(-3, -7, 6, -7) > 4)))
    )
    and 
    not not (
        (not not (not not (not not not cameroon and not not (-6 * -4 <= -10)) or not not not (not (5 - (1 / -6) <= 4) or (max(2, -9, -1, -9) - min(2, -9, -1, -9) > 7)))
        or 
        not not not (not not not ((10 * -2 <= 10) and (9 * -9 > 8)) and not not (not not (-8 - (2 / 7) > 7) or not not not (6 - (-6 / -6) <= 9)))
        )
    )
)

# Expression B
B = (not (not (not (not not not (not not ((-5 * -3 + -2 * -1 > -2 * -6) or (3 * -2 <= -3)) or not not not False) and not not (-5 * -3 + 8 * 1 > -10 * -8)) or jordan) and True) and (-9 - (6 / 3) > -8)) and (-5 - (7 / -5) > -9))

# Expression C
C = not not not (not ((not not not (not canada and not not True) or ((-5 * -6 > 3) or (4 * 5 <= -4))) or (not (not not not (8 * -8 > 10) and not not False) or (not (2 - (8 / 10) <= -8) or (-5 * -9 + -3 * -9 > -2 * -4)))) and not not (not not not (not (not (10 - (10 / 5) <= -1) or True) or (not not (max(7, -10, -1, 5) - min(7, -10, -1, 5) <= 2) or not not not (max(6, 10, -3, 6) - min(6, 10, -3, 6) > 2))) and not not (not (not not not True and not not (max(1, 7, -10, 7) - min(1, 7, -10, 7) <= 8)) or (not not (-3 * 3 + 2 * -1 > -2 * 4) or not not not (1 - (10 / -7) > 1)))))

# Expression D
D = not (not not not (not (not not not ((not not (not not (not not not (((5 * -10 + 9 * -1 > 4 * -7) or (2 - (8 / 3) > 8)) or (5 * 8 > -8)) and not not iran) or not not not (9 - (-10 / 3) <= -9)) or not not not (1 * 9 + -6 * -1 <= 1 * -4)) or (10 - (4 / -1) <= -10)) and not not False) or (1 * -8 <= -9)) and not not True) or (10 * 9 <= 7))

# Expression E
E = not not not (((not not (not (not not (((not (not not False or not not not (max(7, 4, 3, -6) - min(7, 4, 3, -6) <= 2)) and (max(-10, -9, -10, 7) - min(-10, -9, -10, 7) > 8)) or (6 - (-1 / 10) <= 5)) or (-8 * -10 + 1 * 7 <= -6 * 2)) or not not not (-6 * 9 + -8 * -5 <= 7 * -7)) or (4 * -9 + -1 * -1 > -4 * -1)) or not not not (1 * 8 + 8 * 7 > -4 * 9)) and True) or uae) and not not (-1 * -7 + 10 * -7 > -6 * 1))

print(f"A: {A}")
print(f"B: {B}")
print(f"C: {C}")
print(f"D: {D}")
print(f"E: {E}")

results = {'A': A, 'B': B, 'C': C, 'D': D, 'E': E}
true_results = [k for k, v in results.items() if v]
print(f"\nTrue expressions: {true_results}")
print(f"Number of True expressions: {len(true_results)}")
if len(true_results) == 1:
    print(f"ANSWER: {true_results[0]}")
EOF
